content.user_title: Build a Daily Science Roleplay Routine
content.value_statement: Science roleplay scenes can lose structure and character consistency. This skill provides a staged routine for calm field research, observations, and discoveries.
actual_capabilities: Sets a five-stage roleplay sequence from station setup to a research breakthrough.
Provides sample dialogue for collecting, classifying, and analyzing fictional specimens.
Guides the creation of daily research logs with observations, hypotheses, and plans.
Maintains Stella Chen as a thoughtful scientist in a calm exploration setting.
Offers alternate endings for breakthrough, peaceful routine, and collaborative science scenes.
limitations: It provides narrative guidance and does not perform real scientific analysis.
It focuses on the Stella Chen and Gaia setting described in the skill.
It does not retain research logs or game state between conversations.
Scientific terms and discoveries are fictional and require review for factual writing.

use_cases.title: Run a calm exploration scene
use_cases.description: Use the staged routine to lead a low-conflict science roleplay after a survival-focused story arc.

use_cases.title: Draft a scientist character scene
use_cases.description: Create structured dialogue that shows a character collecting evidence, forming hypotheses, and reflecting on discovery.

use_cases.title: Plan a collaborative research chapter
use_cases.description: Adapt the research station and discovery prompts into a scene where two cultures exchange scientific knowledge.

prompt_templates.title: Start the research station
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Daily Science Routine to begin a calm scene where Stella builds a small research station after survival becomes stable.

prompt_templates.title: Collect morning samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide Stella through a morning sample-collection scene. Include three distinct observations and a concise field log.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a testable hypothesis
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue Daily Science Routine with Stella analyzing alien plants. Present evidence, uncertainty, and one safe fictional experiment.

prompt_templates.title: Write a full research day
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete Daily Science Routine chapter with station setup, collection, analysis, evening log, and a breakthrough. Preserve Stella's calm scientific voice.

output_examples.input: Help Stella document a newly found glowing moss.
output: Sample 016 receives a temporary name and collection details.
Stella records light level, temperature, and a microscope observation.
The scene ends with a cautious hypothesis for later testing.

output_examples.input: End the research day with a reflective log.
output: A dated field log lists observations, open questions, and tomorrow's plan.
Stella reflects on the satisfaction of careful research despite isolation.

best_practices: State the current story stage and desired emotional tone before starting.
Treat discoveries as hypotheses until the scene provides observations or tests.
Keep each response focused on one research activity or narrative beat.
anti_patterns: Do not present fictional discoveries as verified real science.
Do not force a breakthrough before the collection and analysis stages establish evidence.
Do not change Stella into an action-focused character when the requested tone is calm and methodical.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It guides an interactive science-fiction roleplay about Stella's daily research routine on Gaia.

faq.question: Does it perform real scientific research?
faq.answer: No. It creates fictional scenes and should not replace scientific sources or analysis.

faq.question: Can I use it for a single scene?
faq.answer: Yes. You can request one stage, such as sample collection or an evening research log.

faq.question: Can I adapt the setting?
faq.answer: Yes. You can replace Gaia details, but the supplied material is written for Stella Chen's setting.

faq.question: How long is a full chapter?
faq.answer: The source suggests a 25 to 30 minute interactive chapter.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
